name: Garnier Anti Dryness Super Uv with Glycerin 50+
description: Garnier Ambre Solaire Anti-Age Super UV Protection Cream reduces the appearance of wrinkles as well as reducing the appearance of dark spots. Containing hyaluronic acid and niacinamide, it leaves skin looking hydrated, smooth and feeling firmer whilst also protected. Our formula is instantly absorbed and does not leave a greasy finish on skin.
